answer: Audits are entered in ocean, queued in comet, and plume publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 32 identities per epoch. A farm of 60 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1228 identities would post 4938 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
